blocker.summary: No suitable WSL2 distribution remained already Running when guest-side evidence collection would have begun.
blocker.details: The first prerequisite scan observed Ubuntu-24.04 as Running. The final authoritative non-starting confirmation, wsl.exe -l -v, showed Ubuntu-24.04, Ubuntu-22.04, and docker-desktop all Stopped. This evidence task is not authorized to start WSL, so the required guest mapping observations could not be collected without breaking the contract.
blocker.required_authority: A human or meta-orchestrator must provide a fresh native Windows evidence dispatch only after a pre-existing registered WSL2 distribution is already Running.
blocker.handoff_prompt: Re-dispatch native Windows evidence for R2-3Z/WIN-EVIDENCE only after a pre-existing registered WSL2 distribution is already Running on the host. Reuse the same source ref/commit/tree and continue the mapping-only contract without lifecycle actions.

unclaimed: Provisioning, product pipe transport, forwarder activation, and native lifecycle work remain unclaimed.
